data.long_meaning: Jaffer is an Arabic name that refers to a stream or river, symbolizing abundance and prosperity. In Islamic tradition, it's a name associated with virtue and good character. The name Jaffer carries the meaning “Stream or River” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaffer usually hope their child will grow to embody stream or river and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaffer total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: جعفر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من جعفريه، يعني الجري علي الشيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: جعفر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الجري على الشيء، الإسراع، و هو من أسماء الصحابة و التابعين، و يعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: جعفر
in_urdu.meaning: جعفریہ سے ماخوذ، مطلب ہے کسی چیز پر چلنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: جعفر ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز پر چلنا، 서두르는، اور یہ صحابہ اور تابعین کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اسے ایک محبوب نام माना جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: जाफ़र

in_hindi.long_meaning: जाफ़र एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी मूल से है और इसका अर्थ है किसी चीज़ पर चलना, 서두르는, और यह सहाबा और ताबीइन के नामों में से एक है, और इस्लामी संस्कृति में इसे एक प्रिय नाम माना जाता है

in_pashto.name: جعفر
in_pashto.meaning: د جعفري څخه اخستل شوی، مانا يې پر کښې چلول

in_english.name: Jaffer
in_english.meaning: Derived from Ja'fariyah, means to move quickly or to hurry
in_english.long_meaning: Jaffer is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'j-f-r' which means 'to move quickly' or 'to hurry'. It is a name of significant historical and spiritual importance in Islamic tradition, associated with Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, a cousin and companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name symbolizes swiftness, agility, and eagerness in pursuing righteous endeavors.
